articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center
body: To the editor: I have lived on Cherry Place for 25 years, and I want to say what a difference the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center has made. Please keep the Saturday cleanup day in the budget. Many of us on Cherry Place use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Celia Emerson, Mill Hill

articles.title: Neighbors Clean Up Harbor Court Ahead of the Summer Fair
articles.deck: Organizers expect about 17 people and say book exchange box is the main draw.
body: Helena Dalrymple, who has lived on Harbor Court for 17 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. The Upper Commons Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library.

articles.title: Julia Eckhart, 63, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Julia Eckhart for the many years of service to Eastgate.
body: Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Julia Eckhart spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program in his or her name.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate. Julia Eckhart died in March at home on Eaton Road, at the age of 63.
